task: WE-2 — Path A DÉMO V1 badges on web loyalty surfaces

design_system_palette.yellow: var(--yellow) = warning/info accent (used on lc-wallet-mark, paymethod-icon--cash, success-modal-bg)
design_system_palette.ink: var(--ink) #0A0A0A — primary text on light/yellow surfaces
design_system_palette.wallet_bg: dark ink (line 519 implies background: var(--ink) gradient)

existing_badge_idioms_in_codebase: lc-eyebrow — uppercase mono accent text (`// label`), already used 5+ times in WebLoyalty
lc-wallet-mark — yellow uppercase mono label inside wallet (line 568)
lc-acc-art-stamp — bold +25/PTS callout on signup modal (account-v2.jsx line 66)

contrast_check.yellow_bg_ink_text: yellow ~#FFD93D + ink #0A0A0A = contrast ratio ~16:1 — passes WCAG AAA
contrast_check.ink_bg_yellow_text: ink #0A0A0A + yellow #FFD93D = contrast ratio ~16:1 — passes WCAG AAA
contrast_check.applies_to: all 3 badge placements (wallet on ink bg, QR area on dark wallet bg, success modal on yellow bg)

recommendations.rationale_text: explicit 'DÉMO V1' surfaces the customer-trust risk: shows demo state without ambiguity. Owner-locked label per task brief. FR-only (site is FR-only — no i18n needed)

placement_1_wallet_head.location: screens.jsx line 569 — inside lc-wallet-head, sibling to lc-wallet-tier
placement_1_wallet_head.color_strategy: yellow background + ink text (mirrors lc-wallet-mark idiom that's already in the same row at line 568)
placement_1_wallet_head.size: match lc-wallet-mark micro-caps (12px mono 700) — same visual rhythm as adjacent label
placement_1_wallet_head.aria_label: Mode démonstration version 1 — points non synchronisés avec la caisse

placement_2_qr_area.location: screens.jsx around line 582-583 — inside lc-wallet-code-body, BELOW the LECAY-347-A9F2C ID line so it sits next to the QR visual
placement_2_qr_area.color_strategy: yellow background + ink text — same as placement 1, visually anchors the demo-state to the QR (the artifact the customer presents at POS)
placement_2_qr_area.size: 11-12px mono uppercase to match existing lc-wallet-code-title micro-caption
placement_2_qr_area.aria_label: Mode démonstration version 1 — ce QR code n'est pas connecté à la caisse

placement_3_success_modal.location: account-v2.jsx around line 224 — inside success state container, just above or sibling-to the '// Bienvenue au club' eyebrow
placement_3_success_modal.color_strategy: ink background + yellow text (inverted on yellow modal bg, gives it stamp/badge feel without disappearing)
placement_3_success_modal.size: 12-14px mono 700 bold — proportional to +25 point headline below
placement_3_success_modal.aria_label: Mode démonstration version 1 — points fictifs, non utilisables en caisse

recommendations.a11y_pattern_choice: plain <span> with aria-label + title attribute (tooltip). Reject role='status' (status is for live updates). Reject role='alert' (alert is for urgent). Plain semantic span = correct for static informational chip per ARIA APG

consistency_with_other_surfaces.loyalty_v2_jsx: OUT of scope per task brief (profile chrome, not in scope WE-2)
consistency_with_other_surfaces.marketing_unauth_screen: screens.jsx line 548 mentions '+25 pts à l'inscription' in marketing copy. NOT a number presented as user balance — out of scope per advisor reconfirmation. Surface in STATUS for owner awareness.

loc_estimate.total_loc: ~6-9 (inline style, no separate CSS file edit)

risk_R1_badge_overlooked.vector: customer reads big '347 pts' number, ignores small DÉMO V1 chip → still believes balance is real
risk_R1_badge_overlooked.mitigation: placement_1 placed in lc-wallet-head row at SAME baseline as lc-wallet-mark which uses identical visual treatment — visually unavoidable; placement_3 placed inside the success modal hero copy area — cannot be missed; placement_2 anchors the QR which is the one artifact presented to POS
risk_R1_badge_overlooked.residual_risk: LOW — three independent placements all in customer-attention hotspots

risk_R2_color_contrast_fail.vector: yellow on light wallet bg insufficient AA
risk_R2_color_contrast_fail.mitigation: wallet bg is dark ink (per line 519 ::before gradient), and the placement is yellow PILL with ink text on the yellow chip itself = 16:1 contrast within the chip. Outside-chip contrast (chip border vs dark wallet) is high also.

risk_R3_i18n_drift.vector: DÉMO V1 hardcoded — what if site adds EN later
risk_R3_i18n_drift.mitigation: site is FR-only V1 per advisor; no i18n infrastructure exists in /Downloads/web/ (no .json catalogs, no t() helper). When site goes multi-lang, badge will be one of the items to translate. Acceptable V1 debt.

verdict: GO — placement strategy + colors + a11y attestable. No frozen-zone touch. ~6-9 LOC across 2 source files. 0 CSS file edits required.
